method: Exact native voxel-boundary surfaces; adjacent coplanar faces merged without changing geometry. No smoothing, downsampling, gap healing or component removal. Artificial crop faces omitted.
coordinate_convention: Voxel cells span [i*resolution,(i+1)*resolution) relative to crop begin; image section plane is (local_z+0.5)*resolution_z. Global nm = local nm + origin_global_nm.
notices: Historical segmentation version 1300; distinct from version 1822 point-ownership checks.
Objects are seed-selected segmentation labels, not validated cell identities or proof of a shared spine.
All disconnected fragments of each selected label inside the crop are retained.
Open cutoffs at crop limits are not anatomical endings.
Inspect serial EM to assess membrane continuity and synaptic morphology.
attribution: MICrONS Consortium (2025), Functional connectomics spanning multiple areas of mouse visual cortex. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-08790-w
